_about: Golden questions for the external agent. 'value' + 'tolerance' (absolute) is matched against the agent's key_figures; 'text_contains' against the answer text (case-insensitive). 'expect_tools_any' scores tool choice. Expected values were read from the demo data on 2026-09-24; update them if the demo data is re-seeded.
